mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in FEDFUNDS above 4.5% over two consecutive quarters signals a tightening monetary regime that raises real interest rates and reduces present value of future corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 achieves positive 60-day forward returns in more than 60% of quarters when the trigger is met, or the median return is not significantly below zero at 5% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in GDPC1 below -2% indicates a contraction in aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and depresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 posts positive 20-day forward returns in more than 50% of GDP contraction episodes, or the mean return is not significantly negative at 5% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in UNRATE above 6.5% for three consecutive months signals an overheating labor market that accelerates wage inflation, prompting the Fed to raise rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 achieves positive 5-day forward returns in more than 60% of triggered months, or the median return is not significantly below zero at 5% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent fall in PAYEMS and rise in UNRATE above 0.5 percentage points within a month indicates accelerating wage growth outpacing employment expansion, which increases cost pressures and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during triggered months, or the interaction coefficient in a regression of returns on the constructed signal is not significant at 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in HOUST below its 12-month moving average by more than 5% signals weakening housing demand, which negatively impacts construction and related equities, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST < 12-month MA by > 5% for three consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 posts positive 20-day forward returns in more than 55% of triggered episodes, or the mean return is not significantly below zero at 5% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in INDPRO below its 6-month moving average by more than 2% for four consecutive months signals weakening industrial production, which reduces earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 6-month MA by > 2% for four consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 achieves positive 60-day forward returns in more than 60% of triggered periods, or the median return is not significantly below zero at 5% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in FEDFUNDS and a fall in RSAFS by more than 3% month-over-month signals a tightening liquidity stance, which increases funding costs and reduces corporate investment, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases AND RSAFS falls by > 3% MoM
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during triggered months, or the interaction term in a regression of returns on the joint signal is not significant at 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent annual CPIAUCSL increase above 3% for six consecutive months signals entrenched inflation, which increases the probability of aggressive Fed tightening and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 achieves positive 60-day forward returns in more than 55% of triggered periods, or the median return is not significantly below zero at 5% confidence.
